name: Kitagawa Aya
source:
A lively, cheerful, sporty girl who is a member of the swimming club.
She has a straightforward personality and doesn't mince words.
She doesn't mean to bully Murakoshi, but she does say some pretty harsh things to him.
She has short hair and a fairly large chest.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.blackrainbow.jp/br/gakuen/gakuen_chara.html]official site[/url]]
